items.description: The aim of Food Care is to create a healthy service for clients interested to purchase web and mobile applications. The Food Care app offers resources from local dietitians targeted to a local community. The benefits of this app include connection to local restaurants, introduction to prepare healthy recipes, and personalization of a dietary plan.
Personalized healthy recipes in your inbox. Add items that you love to eat like Chinese, apples, or pancakes, and we'll email you a healthy recipe each day to make.
Particle Reviews leverages the Rotten tomatoes API and Hulu's unofficial API to provide movie ratings on its site.
Lets two people connect by phone without revealing their numbers to each other. For use where privacy might be an issue such as online classifieds.
Bitcoin ATM uses AngularJS and the Coinkite API to simulate a Bitcoin vending machine. In addition to Bitcoins, it can also dispense Litecoins and Blackcoins.
Guidespot.com is about Conspiracy America. It is a coast-to-coast tour, a fun-filled look at the current state of National Paranoia.

A Firefox Greasemonkey script to embed a geo this button within the WordPress admin screen. Click the button and it makes a YQL call to Placemaker, sending along the contents of your post. It embeds the results in the Geo microformat.
Map based search for lowest petrol price and station locations around Western Australia.

Grabbing trends from Google, Twitter, Yahoo! & YouTube and aggregating them into a single site. View trend snapshots (taken about every 45 min.), or blended into a daily wordcloud visualization to see relative trend popularity for the day.

Tutrme.com is a free global tutor database helping connect local tutors with students. The graphical map-based directory interface helps students to not have to hunt through loads of useless information in their search for a local, qualified tutor.
Online shopping based on Amazon eCommerce. Written as a hybrid of PHP and Perl. Stores data in flat files. More then 60,000 products in over 60 categories.
Fitcheck is an application that lets users to keep track of how active they are throughout the day. This application uses the Fitbit API service.
A fun and educational way to track the status of U.S. legislation, highlighting the actual locations where law gets made.
Weekly Top Bollywood Songs based on Youtube view count
The site allows you to search YouTube videos and then merge and edit them together to make power hour videos. Once the video is published, it is keyworded from YouTube's data api.
For history buffs and school kids, a mashup showing where presidents/first ladies were born. From George Washington through George Bush.
Search through MLS listings in the SF Bay Area via this Google Maps mashup.
Explore the sounds of New York City with this aural map from the New York Society for Acoustic Ecology. Audio is directly integrated into the map marker popups. Nicely done.
Instant portfolio assembly on iGoogle
Uses Yahoo BBAuth API to let you use your Yahoo account as an OpenID.

Lets a business share docs from their Microsoft SkyDrive over SMS via Twilio. Go to the app which is running on Windows Azure, set which SkyDrive account to use, and select a public file to share over SMS. Customers (incl. potential customers) can call the Twilio number associated with the #docs deployment and text link to get a link to whatever doc you're currently sharing (for deals, specials, marketing info, etc.) For the sample #docs deployment, call my Twilio number (415)599-2671, enter passcode 7392-3266, and message link.
Gives you overflown countries between 2 points on Earth following the great circle (it's more or less the air route).
Visualization of your favorite artists on the world map.
A mashup for rating photos on Flickr.
See dozens of current terror threats or incidents around the world. Includes airport, chemical, bridge, railway, bomb and other incidents. With links to related news stories and searchable database.
Real estate portal of luxury homes and condos in the San Francisco Bay Area. It shows $2.9 million+ properties and updated daily with new listings.

Easy WordPress based system that allows you to manage SMS campaigns for yourself or on behalf of your clients. You can also allow clients to send their own messages via the accompanying SMS Butler plugin.
Displays the entire Athens transit system along with estimated arrival times and a trip planner.
Fertility calculator that also integrates with Google Calendar.
Generative fiction with Google Maps and Flickr.
Its simple App to bypass twitter 140 characters restriction.

Wikipedia-roll is a global and dynamic version of articles from Wikipedia. Gives access to a global vision of a subject through the definition and items of the article in Wikipedia. Then by mashup serendipity, it discovers a lot of things.

This open-source App Engine implementation of the Twilio Client lets you deploy your own browser-based phone application. The app provides the following functions... - Make outbound calls from your browser - Receive inbound calls inside your browser - Receive browser-to-browser calls from friends - Manage voicemails when you aren't logged in to answer calls - SMS notifications when a new voicemail arrives
A HelloSalut + Google Maps mashup.
Bookafy is an online scheduling and appointment tracking web app. This mashup makes use of the Zendesk Core API for ticket tracking and management.
PeepGift emails you sweet Groupon deals for the cities your Facebook friends and family live in when their birthday or a holiday is coming up.
Tracks and graphs Amazon price history. Allows user to be emailed when the price hits a desired point.
Compare Prices website based on the eBay Commerce API platform. Site is fully responsive and can adapt to any screen size including mobile.
MyKorea is a kind of a shell which can display every geospatial data concerning Korea I am interested in.
Allows Box.net users to send files from their Box accounts to Snipshot to be edited, then save them directly back to Box from within Snipshot.
Find areas to hike and explore in NE Indiana. ACRES has been dedicated to acquiring and preserving natural areas since 1960.
Filmfinder is a mobile application that lets users browse and search for movies and TV series. Filmfinder uses a few different APIs for their database, including Youtube and Movie DB.
